component.name: NAM-X
component.summary: Play Neural Amp Modeler profiles and impulse responses live

description.p: NAM-X is a standalone guitar rig for Linux and Windows built on Neural Amp Modeler. Load any .nam model and .wav impulse response from the community, play through it live with a few milliseconds of latency, and shape the sound with a freely reorderable effects chain: tuner, transpose, noise gate, compressor, dynamic wah, flanger, phaser, Tube Screamer drive, volume pedal, four-band EQ, chorus, tremolo, ping-pong delay, reverb and cab simulation.
A library panel keeps models, IRs and presets one click away, with search, favorites and recents. Presets carry the whole rig: every setting, the effect order and the model and IR they use.
Audio goes through JACK or PipeWire on Linux and WASAPI on Windows. NAM-X is an independent project and is not affiliated with the official Neural Amp Modeler plugin.

screenshot.caption: The rack with a Mesa model and a Celestion V30 cabinet loaded

description.p: First public release: reorderable effects chain, library panel, presets, MIDI control, tuner and metronome, JACK/PipeWire and WASAPI backends.
